setting: fair_leakfree, balanced, reference100 includes10 synthetic tests; seeds0-4; standard/disjoint
audit: Do not repeat variance, general parser-difficulty, severity classification or global U tuning. Reconstruct only missing exact score/geometry comparisons and validate old AUC/test/ref populations first.

hypotheses.H1: Reference familiarity predicts Clotho score/errors; novel structures degrade label agreement
hypotheses.H2: Identical representations/references contain failure information that PASS-only GMM scoring extracts poorly
hypotheses.H3: Unstable repeated-generation labels account for apparent misses and performance gaps
alternatives: geometry dominated by prompt/norm or generic structure

recovery: Use seeded log_parsing_phase3_lib.clotho_run. Same original software versions where needed. Accept exact test/ref IDs and AUC tolerance1e-12. Failures are logged, never approximated. Disjoint cached joined scores additionally checked.
binary: Separate original-test templates into calibration/evaluation halves using existing SHA256(model,system,seed,GT template) parity. On calibration only maximize balanced accuracy of raw failure-risk threshold; ties choose larger threshold. Classification/margins and qualitative sampling use evaluation half only; full original-test continuous AUC remains separate. No score becomes a claimed probability.

similarity.lexical: character3-5gram TF-IDF fit only on90 real reference raw logs, max cosine
similarity.structural: observable input-only nine features standardized by reference, max1/(1+Euclidean distance)
similarity.hidden: raw stored fair-layer cosine vs90 real references; centered-cosine sensitivity; max also passing/failing references separately
similarity.oracle: GT template familiarity/nearest-template agreement excluded from deployable features

probes.same_space_LR: C1 balanced LR on exact captured Clotho PCA coordinates and same100 reference labels, no source/output features, no retuning
probes.same_space_LR_real_only: drop10 synthetic reference rows, keep representation fixed
probes.raw_hidden_LR: reference-fitted scaler + PCA16 + C1 balanced LR, same100 labels; diagnostic representation alternative
probes.lexical_LR: train-reference char TF-IDF + C1 balanced LR,90 real labels
probes.structural_LR: same observable features + C1 balanced LR,90 real labels
probes.identity: nearest-reference GT agreement and chance-adjusted diagnostics; exclude sameGT neighbors for failure agreement; no claim of causal memorization
probes.same_space_two_density: Contrast separately fitted FAIL GMM against captured original PASS GMM, same PCA coordinates, component count/reg_covar, random seed/n_init30; log-density ratio, no test tuning; skip if insufficient FAIL refs

strata: Within-job similarity quartiles (labels unused). Report prevalence/n and AUC/AP only with>=10 of each class. Stable labels=0/5 or5/5 passes; borderline=2/5 or3/5. Existing40-sample findings reused, not refit.

slots: 3 seeded representatives emphasizing seen/unseen and stable/unstable availability
sampling.constraints: unique input and at most2/system per cell, prefer unique GT templates; report shortfalls, no forced replacement across cells

matching: FN→TP and FP→TN same model/system/split/seed0/label, same stability bin, same stored sample0 primary proxy, same GT variable-type flags; nearest GT variable-count and length, tolerance variables±1 and length±5 tokens. Seen→unseen standard same model/system/label/stability, same tolerances and template FAIL prevalence difference<=0.2. Diagnostic GT features never predictor inputs. No forced matches.
statistics: system-cluster bootstrap of system means preserving five seeds; descriptive template-conditioned contrasts; template-clustered explanatory regressions where feasible; no line-IID tests or causal claims
qualitative: Assistant reads all sampled raw logs/GT/sample0 and label-batch outputs/references/margins; writes case-specific hypotheses and counterexamples. LLM judgment is exploratory and not independent human annotation. No external LLM inference.
